copy.leadToOrg: A new org card is created and linked to this one. Everything below is copied unless you change or untick it. Copied comments and history become visible to the whole org.
copy.leadToPrivate: A new private card, visible only to you, is created and linked to this one. The org card is not changed.
copy.cancelSource: Cancel this private card after promoting

admin.title: Administration
loginIssues.lead: Messages from people who could not sign in, sent with "Message an admin" on the sign-in page. Open ones are listed first. Reply by email; to give someone access, invite them under Users.
loginIssues.emptyBody: When someone who cannot sign in messages the admins, it shows here.
mail.lead: Change what each email says. Placeholders like {cardKey} are filled in when the email is sent; the layout and the Open in Kanban button stay as they are.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.saved: Saved. The next emails of this kind use this text.
mail.previewNote: With sample values - nothing is sent. The email keeps the Kanban layout and the Open in Kanban button.
mail.resetBody: {email} goes back to the built-in wording. Your edited text is removed.
admin.deleteTeamBody: Only an empty team (no projects, no cards) can be deleted.
admin.leadHint: A team lead manages this team's members, projects and Teams channel.
admin.leadScope: You lead these teams. Teams, programs, tags, people and roles stay with an admin.
admin.removeNoCards: They have no open cards in this team.
admin.removeLead: They hold {n} open cards in this team. Reassign any of them; the rest become open work (no assignee).
admin.releaseWarning: {n} of these will be released and sent back to the team’s Backlog.
admin.deleteProgramBody: Only a program without projects can be deleted.
admin.inProgram: In program {name}; its end date caps this one.
admin.dateConflict: A project would end after its program (the program ends on {date}). Make the dates coincide:
admin.reteamHint: Changing the team moves every card of the project to the new team (one event per card).
projects.stoppedTip: Not accepting new cards. Click to resume intake.
projects.acceptingTip: Accepting new cards. Click to stop intake.
admin.closeProjectBody: Every open card below is closed with this comment. Switch a row to Delivered if it shipped; move a card out of the project first if it should carry on.
admin.closeNoOpen: No open cards - the project can be closed as it is.
admin.closeMore: Showing {shown} of {total} open cards; close in batches or raise the search limit.
admin.reopenProjectBody: The project takes cards again from where it left off; the cards closed with it stay closed.
admin.deleteProjectBody: Only a project without cards can be deleted.
admin.usersLead: People are admitted here (D-083): invite them with at least one team; they sign in with their Microsoft account once the invitation arrives.
problem.NOT_EMPTY: It still contains projects or cards. Empty it first.
problem.NAME_TAKEN: That name is already in use.
problem.SAME_PLANE: The card is already on that plane.
backlog.lead: All unplanned and upcoming work items. Prioritize and move to board when ready.
backlog.sort.title: Title (A → Z)
backlog.selectPage: Select every card on this page
backlog.overdueTip: Overdue: the due date has passed

calendar.emptyMonth: No cards are due this month.
top.search: Search tasks, projects, teams or keywords
top.searchPlaceholder: Search tasks, projects, teams or keywords…
tags.noneDefined: No tags defined yet. An admin adds them under Administration > Tags.
admin.tagsLead: Tags are a shared vocabulary: members pick from this list, they cannot invent new ones. Renaming a tag updates every card that carries it.
admin.deleteTagBody: Only a tag that is on no card can be deleted.
problem.UNKNOWN_TAG: That tag is not in the vocabulary. Ask an admin to add it.
profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: How you appear to others. Once Microsoft sign-in is on, your name and picture come from your Microsoft profile unless you set your own here.
profile.name: Display name
profile.pictureHint: Any image; it is resized to a small square before upload.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lead: Changes by others on cards you hold, created or commented on, and in your teams - newest first, grouped by what changed.
inbox.clearHint: Everything on or before that date leaves your inbox. The card history keeps it.
inbox.empty.title: Nothing new
inbox.empty.body: When someone assigns you a card, comments on yours, or changes something in your teams, it shows up here.
comment.mentionHint: Write a comment - type @ to mention someone
files.title: Title
files.hint: Files stay where they live (SharePoint, OneDrive, Blob); only the link is kept here. Access is governed by that system.
docs.title: Documents
problem.NOT_TOP_LEVEL: Replies go on a top-level comment.
time.totalOwn: You logged {logged} h · effort {effort} h (only your own hours are shown)
reports.csv.lead: Hours per person, card and day for a period. Both dates are required; the team and program filters above apply.
reports.csv.lastDaysHint: Fills From and To below; you can still change either date.
reports.csv.backwards: The start date is after the end date.
reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Org cards only. Cancelled is shown separately and not counted as open. Today is {today}.
reports.subtitle: Organization-wide work and effort overview
reports.leadPeriod: Org cards created or closed in {month}, and hours logged in {month}. Cancelled is counted apart, not as open. Today is {today}.
reports.cancelledTip: Cancelled cards in this view - shown apart, not counted as open
reports.summarySub: Detailed breakdown of work items and effort by {group}
reports.overdueSub: Open cards past their due date, as of today
reports.chart.noHours: No effort or logged hours yet.
prefs.notifyHint: You always get an email when a card is assigned to you, and the weekly time reminders. This adds an email when one of your cards is blocked.
prefs.inboxHint: How far back your inbox reaches. Older changes stay on the cards themselves.
prefs.notifyLabel: Also email me when one of my cards is blocked
admin.teamsWebhookHint: Paste an incoming-webhook URL to post assignments, blocks, comments and closures of this team's cards. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
problem.NOT_CONFIGURED: This feature is not configured on the server.
prefs.defaultsTitle: My defaults on the Org tab
prefs.defaultsHint: Cards of your default team and project come first in every column of My board › Org.
signIn.notAdmitted: You are not on the list yet. Ask an admin to add you to Kanban.
signIn.failed: Microsoft sign-in did not complete ({code}). Try again; if it keeps happening, contact an admin.

teamTime.membersHint: Short first; hours on other teams count toward each total
time.daysOffLegend: Days off (each lowers the week's target by 8 h)
